package.name: Finco1 UI-3 LineItemGrid Migration Governance Plan

one_sheet_at_a_time_rule.rule: Each PR migrates exactly one sheet to the shared LineItemGrid partial/macro. No PR migrates multiple sheets. No PR migrates a sheet to a non-shared macro.
enforcement: per-pr visual review by the user (per B36)
per-pr automated test by Agent A (route-render smoke + index context-contract + per-sheet regression)

no_formula_output_change_rule.rule: No PR changes any financial formula, engine output, model output, fixture CSV, schema/migration, or persistence/repository code.

template_parity_rule.rule: The migrated sheet must render the same values, preserve the original CSS class structure, accessibility markers, and read-only state. Must not introduce any new console error or 404 request.
enforcement: per-pr automated test (route-render smoke + index context-contract + per-sheet regression)

css_class_preservation_rule.rule: No PR removes, renames, or changes a CSS class to a non-equivalent class. The migrated sheet may add new CSS classes that are scoped to the migrated sheet and do not affect other sheets.

visual_review_requirement.rule: The visual review is performed by the user or the designated reviewer. Agent B records the visual review protocol (B36). The visual review covers old-vs-new invariants, CSS class preservation, accessibility/read-only marker checks, no-overflow check, no-console-error check, network 404 check, tab navigation check, and GET / check.

route_smoke_context_contract_requirement.rule: The route-render smoke test must pass on the migrated sheet's route. The index context-contract test must pass on the migrated sheet's index page. The per-sheet regression test must pass on the migrated sheet.
enforcement: per-pr automated test (route-render smoke + index context-contract + per-sheet regression)

rollback_condition.rule: The UI-3 migration is rolled back when any of the following conditions are met: financial output drift on TUHO or Oborovo, parity-core lock drift, engine-output golden drift, model output drift, visual invariant break, CSS class preservation rule break, high-severity UX issue in the controlled pilot.

global_notes: UI-3 is a UI migration. UI-3 is not a financial model migration, not a backend migration, not a persistence migration, not a schema/migration, not a parity-core migration.
The Phase 57A LineItemGrid CAPEX pilot is the first UI-3 migration. The Phase 57A pilot is a single-sheet pilot. The full UI-3 migration is gated on the Phase 57A pilot succeeding.
Agent B does not approve code correctness. Agent B does not approve financial output. Agent B does not authorize paid pilot. Agent B records the governance plan.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
